The '''Attack on Ska Gora''' was a battle between the [[Je'daii]] defenders and the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] under the command of [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]].

==Prelude==
The ex-[[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] came up with a plan which involved the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]] and cause his generals to fight each other for dominance. Using his Force Hound training, Xesh managed to locate Skal'nas' base of operations and launched an attack on [[Ska Gora]].

==Battle==
However, this was revealed to be a trap as the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] forces ambushed the Je'daii task force and took many of them prisoner before encasing them in tubes in a chamber under the Rakatan fortress.

==Appearances==
*[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 2]] {{1st}}
